note: Adult Protective Services (APS) reporting routes for every state and D.C., read on each state's official page on the date shown. 'phones' lists only numbers printed on the official page named in 'phone_source' (or 'page' when absent). States with county-based intake and no statewide number on the official page have no phone here; the page tells people how to reach the county. 'facility' is a separate route the same official page gives for people living in nursing homes or other licensed care. Used by scripts/build_core_care.py for elder-abuse.html and the card on each state page.
